author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
I was a middle school teacher when Panic at the Disco first hit at the end of the Pop Punk wave and now my son is in middle school listening to Panic at the Disco when its just one dude and only pop.

At least the music still has range. I swear High Hopes was only song my son listens to that goes over one octave.

I will feel like a failure if my son grows up to love pop. I even have to fake liking "Songland" and "Voice."
